title: Identifying Dead Code Smell
question: Which of the following statements best describes the 'Dead Code' code smell?

options.text: A class performs only one action, delegating work to another class.
A variable, parameter, field, method or class is no longer used (usually because it’s obsolete).
There’s an unused class, method, field or parameter created 'just in case'.
Two code fragments look almost identical.

explanation: 'Dead Code' refers to any part of the codebase (like a variable, parameter, method, or even a class) that is no longer used or executed. This often happens as software evolves and requirements change, and old code isn't cleaned up. It adds clutter and can be misleading.
